name: Silk Road
why: The approach crosses a snowfield at the base of this granite tower, and no glacier is described on the line.
secondReview: unsure/yes: A snowfield on the approach is stated, but whether glacier ice is crossed was not settled.
research: no/unsure: An area page says a snowfield is crossed on the way to the base but is not much of an issue, and a trip report describes a moraine walk.

name: Twisting Couloir
why: The route passes a bergschrund and climbs glacier ice, and the descent leads toward the glacier.
